title: Red Hat Security Advisory: openvswitch2.15 security update
description: Two security vulnerabilities have been identified in Open vSwitch 2.15 related to the DPDK component. The first allows a guest to desynchronize virtqueue size from the inflight descriptor table size, causing an out-of-bounds write (CVE-2026-86565). The second is a time-of-check/time-of-use (TOCTOU) vulnerability that allows a guest to trigger an out-of-bounds write in vhost-crypto (CVE-2026-86848). These issues affect Red Hat Enterprise Linux Fast Datapath 8 on multiple architectures. Red Hat has released security updates to address these vulnerabilities.
